subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram Business Bot support (business_message / business_connection updates)

question: Should bundled Telegram support include Telegram Business personal-DM handling now, and what account-scoped business_connection_id authority model should it use?
rationale: The feature fits major-channel support, but it changes personal-DM access and outbound send authority; automation should not choose that security boundary after the prior same-repo implementation was closed for these concerns.

options.title: Approve bounded bundled support
options.body: Implement Business support in the Telegram plugin with per-account durable connection state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Require a short design note first
options.body: Keep this tracker open but require maintainers to document access control, persistence, and outbound authority before accepting another implementation PR.

options.title: Defer bundled support
options.body: Leave Business chats to external relay approaches until maintainers explicitly approve the bundled Telegram security model or a plugin/API seam.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded bundled support
recommendation.body: Implement Business support in the Telegram plugin with per-account durable connection state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc closed the prior same-repo implementation with the current-owner-direction note and has recent Telegram seam history.
